items.title: Plaintiffs lawyers' fee slashed in Google privacy settlement
items.author: David Thomas, Mike Scarcella
items.creator: David Thomas, Mike Scarcella
items.summary: A U.S. federal judge in San Jose has awarded Bartlit Beck and other plaintiffs’ firms a reduced legal fee of about $29 million for their work on a settlement resolving a lawsuit that accused Google of programming its Android operating system to collect the cellular data of smartphone users without their permission.
items.body:
A U.S. federal judge in San Jose has awarded Bartlit Beck and other plaintiffs’ firms a reduced legal fee of about $29 million for their work on a [USN:L6N3YT0WU TEXT:"settlement"] resolving a lawsuit that accused Google of programming its Android operating system to collect the cellular data of smartphone users without their permission.
Here are the details:
U.S. Magistrate Judge Virginia DeMarchi approved the settlement on Friday but said the requested fee of nearly $40 million would have overcompensated the plaintiffs' lawyers.
The judge said the settlement's primary value was not money for class members but a requirement that Google provide disclosures about Android users' cellular data.
Google in January agreed to pay $135 million to settle the proposed class action. As part of the settlement, the Alphabet unit (GOOGL.O) said it will not transfer data without obtaining consent from Android users when they set up their phones.
“While the value of such transparency cannot be easily or accurately quantified, such relief is still significant in that it enables users to make informed decisions about whether to consent to the cellular data usage and continue using Android devices,” DeMarchi wrote in her order.
The initial $39.8 million sought by lead plaintiffs' attorneys at Bartlit Beck and Korein Tillery amounted to about 29% of the settlement fund. Attorneys at those firms did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Google had opposed the requested legal fees. A spokesperson for the company did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

i
also granted final approval to the settlement on Friday.

FAST

WASHINGTON, Aug 24 : U.S. President Donald Trump invested as much as $50,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, according to a public financial disclosure, giving him a financial stake in a major government contractor run by his former adviser. 
He bought between $15,001 and $50,000 in shares on June 23, according to a financial disclosure signed by him on August 12 and made public on August 22. The purchase was part of more than 1,000 stock trades the president made in June.
SpaceX held its initial public offering on June 12, which demolished IPO records. 
In a statement to Reuters, White House spokesman Davis Ingle said that third-party financial institutions independently manage the president's portfolio and replicate "recognized indexes, such as the Schwab 1000."

"Neither President Trump nor any member of his family has any ability to direct, influence, or provide input regarding how the portfolio is invested or when investments are bought or sold," Ingle said in the statement. 
Trump's investment in SpaceX adds a new financial link between the president and Musk's rocket company at a time when the administration is making decisions that could affect the firm's fortunes.
SpaceX is a U.S. military contractor, and often seeks approvals from federal agencies. Trump on Thursday directed his team to help drastically increase the number of U.S. commercial space launches. SpaceX is a dominant player in that sector. 
Reuters could not immediately determine the precise amount of the investment because federal officials use ranges to declare the value of their assets on their financial disclosure forms.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia killed in South Sudan ambush
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia were killed and seven other people injured in an ambush on Monday in South Sudan's Jonglei State, bringing to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in the line of duty worldwide this year, the United Nations said.
items.body:
Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia were killed and seven other people injured in an ambush on Monday in South Sudan's Jonglei State, bringing to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in the line of duty worldwide this year, the United Nations said.
Among the injured were three U.N. peacekeepers, two police officers from South Sudan and two civilian staff members, U.N. spokesperson Stephane Dujarric told a press briefing.
He said the attack was carried out by unidentified gunmen and the patrol appeared to have been deliberately targeted.
"These are part of regular patrols that the U.N. has been doing in trying to help the constant insecurity in the area," Dujarric said.
The U.N. has called on relevant authorities for a thorough and prompt investigation to ensure all those responsible are brought to justice, Dujarric said. He stressed that "attacks against U.N. peacekeepers may constitute war crimes under international law."
The latest violence "brings to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in malicious acts since January 1 of this year," he added.
Attacks on U.N. personnel are rare but not unprecedented in South Sudan, where U.N. patrols operate in volatile areas affected by intercommunal fighting, armed youth mobilizations and clashes involving government forces.
In June, the U.N. Security Council adopted a resolution aimed at [USN:L1N42U11Y TEXT:"strengthening accountability for attacks on U.N. peacekeepers"], amid concern over rising violence and low prosecution rates.
That followed a series of incidents targeting U.N. personnel, including the [USN:L1N42C0PN TEXT:"killing of seven peacekeepers serving with the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon"] after a fresh round of fighting broke out between Israel and Hezbollah in early March.

items.summary: A Alibaba lançou oficialmente nesta segunda-feira seu mais recente modelo de geração de vídeo com inteligência artificial, o Wan3.0, com recursos aprimorados, após a gigante chinesa da internet ter lançado uma emissão de ações no valor de US$10 bilhões para financiar os crescentes gastos com IA.
items.body:
A Alibaba (9988.HK) lançou oficialmente nesta segunda-feira seu mais recente modelo de geração de vídeo com inteligência artificial, o Wan3.0, com recursos aprimorados, após a gigante chinesa da internet ter lançado uma emissão de ações no valor de US$10 bilhões para financiar os crescentes gastos com IA.
O novo modelo é capaz de gerar vídeos de 30 segundos a partir de documentos, planilhas, apresentações e páginas da web, informou a Alibaba Cloud em uma publicação na plataforma WeChat.
A Alibaba informou que o Wan3.0 vem sendo utilizado na produção de curtas-metragens e filmes, em publicidade e marketing, na promoção turística e na criação de videoclipes desde que uma versão beta pública foi lançada em 6 de agosto.
O lançamento ocorre um dia após o Alibaba ter anunciado a venda de ações, a maior oferta primária subsequente já realizada por uma empresa listada em Hong Kong, à medida que aumenta seus gastos na cada vez mais acirrada corrida global pela IA.
Na semana passada, a Alibaba divulgou uma queda de 75% nos lucros trimestrais em relação ao ano anterior, devido ao aumento vertiginoso dos gastos de capital relacionados à IA.
(Reportagem de Ethan Wang e Eduardo Baptista)

items.title: Italy regulator clears Ludoil's acquisition of Sicilian oil refiner
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Italy's competition authority has cleared the acquisition of Sicily-based oil refiner ISAB by energy group Ludoil, the watchdog said on Monday, opening the way for a local company to control one fifth of the country's refining capacity.
items.body:
Italy's competition authority has cleared the [USN:L8N41Q1HU TEXT:"acquisition"] of Sicily-based oil refiner ISAB by energy group Ludoil, the watchdog said on Monday, opening the way for a local company to control one fifth of the country's refining capacity.
Ludoil agreed in May to buy 51% of ISAB from Cypriot private equity fund G.O.I. Energy, subject to several conditions.
The antitrust regulator said that the transaction would not hamper competition in the Italian market for refined products in a significant way, adding it would not open a full investigation on the acquisition.
The refiner is linked to an exclusive long-term contract with global commodity trader Trafigura until 2033, the watchdog said in its document, revealing interesting details regarding its business.
The supply and offtake agreement commits ISAB to sell approximately 90% of its refined petroleum products to Trafigura while Trafigura supplies ISAB with crude oil and the other raw materials required for refining, the competition authority said.

items.title: Israeli fire kills two young children in Gaza, medics say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said.
items.body:
Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said.
Medics and relatives said 10-year-old Amal Abu Khater was hit by a bullet in her back while she was eating inside her family's tent in the enclave's southern city of Khan Younis. The fire came from Israeli forces to the east, they added.
The Israeli military said it was not aware of any incident involving a 10-year-old girl.
A four-year-old boy and another Palestinian were killed in separate Israeli airstrikes on a house in Bureij refugee camp and a road in Khan Younis, medics said.
Earlier on Monday, another Israeli airstrike killed one person and wounded another at a tent in Deir Al-Balah in the central Gaza Strip, medics said.
The Israeli military said that strike in Deir Al-Balah targeted a Hamas militant, but did not specifically respond to questions about the other two reported attacks in Khan Younis and Bureij.
More than 1,280 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since a ceasefire took effect last October , according to Gazan health officials, while the Israeli military says four Israeli soldiers have been killed.
Hamas accuses Israel of violating the ceasefire and undermining efforts to implement a broader plan by U.S. President Donald Trump to end the Gaza conflict, which also includes Israeli withdrawals and Hamas disarmament.
Israel says its strikes aimed to thwart imminent attacks by Hamas and other Gaza militants.
The Israeli military issued two separate evacuation orders in Beach refugee camp and Deir Al-Balah in northern and central Gaza Strip before it carried out airstrikes in the two areas, without reports of casualties, residents and medics said.
It also bombed a desalination plant in the Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood in Gaza City, at a time when the enclave is suffering water shortages, residents and Hamas said.
An Israeli military spokesperson said the military had carried out strikes on several Hamas weapons storage sites throughout the day, including two inside mosques.
The spokesperson said that among the sites targeted on Monday was one located adjacent to a desalination facility.
The spokesperson said the military had not targeted the desalination facility and did not say whether or not it had been damaged in the strike.

items.title: Xiaomi lança novo chip Xring e faz parceria com TSMC para produção
items.author: Che Pan, Eduardo Baptista
items.creator: Che Pan, Eduardo Baptista
items.summary: A fabricante chinesa de smartphones Xiaomi divulgou nesta segunda-feira uma nova versão de seu microprocessador desenvolvido internamente, o Xring, apostando que um controle mais profundo sobre os principais componentes ajudará a fortalecer sua cadeia de suprimentos e a reduzir a dependência de fornecedores externos de chips.
items.body:
A fabricante chinesa de smartphones Xiaomi (1810.HK) divulgou nesta segunda-feira uma nova versão de seu microprocessador desenvolvido internamente, o Xring, apostando que um controle mais profundo sobre os principais componentes ajudará a fortalecer sua cadeia de suprimentos e a reduzir a dependência de fornecedores externos de chips.
O lançamento do Xring O3 ocorre um ano após a Xiaomi ter lançado seu primeiro processador próprio para smartphones, o Xring O1, marcando o mais recente passo da terceira maior fabricante mundial de smartphones em sua iniciativa de se juntar a rivais como Apple (AAPL.O) , Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) e Huawei no desenvolvimento de seus próprios chips.
A TSMC (2330.TW) fabricará o novo chip da Xiaomi utilizando tecnologia de produção de 3 nanômetros, segundo duas fontes a par do assunto.
Uma das fontes disse que o chip deve equipar o próximo smartphone dobrável da Xiaomi, com uma meta de entregas de 200 mil a 300 mil unidades.
Representantes da Xiaomi e da TSMC não comentaram o assunto.
Os processadores de smartphones, ou sistemas em chip (SoC), integram funções de computação, gráficos, processamento de IA e imagem em um único componente.
A aposta da Xiaomi em chips reflete uma tendência mais ampla do setor, à medida que os fabricantes de dispositivos buscam diferenciar seus produtos e diminuir a dependência de fornecedores como Qualcomm (QCOM.O) e MediaTek (2454.TW) em meio à intensificação da concorrência no segmento de smartphones premium.
A Xiaomi afirmou na semana passada que as vendas acumuladas de dispositivos equipados com o Xring O1 — incluindo smartphones, tablets e relógios — ultrapassaram 1 milhão de unidades desde seu lançamento.
A Xiaomi vendeu cerca de 150 mil smartphones equipados com Xring O1 desde o lançamento, em maio de 2025, segundo as fontes.

items.title: France, Saudi Arabia agree on €6 billion Dragon Ball Z theme park project near Paris
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: France and Saudi Arabia have agreed to build a €6 billion ($7 billion) manga-themed amusement park near Paris, the Elysee Palace said on Monday during a visit by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to the French capital.
items.body:
France and Saudi Arabia have agreed to build a €6 billion ($7 billion) manga-themed amusement park near Paris, the Elysee Palace said on Monday during a visit by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to the French capital.
The project, inspired by the world of the hit Japanese manga and anime franchise Dragon Ball Z, will be built near Cergy-Pontoise, northwest of Paris, and is expected to create around 22,000 jobs, the Elysee said.
The idea was born after French President Emmanuel Macron and the Saudi crown prince discovered a shared enthusiasm for Dragon Ball Z during Macron’s visit to Saudi Arabia in 2025, Macron advisers said.
Saudi entertainment and investment group Qiddiya will finance the project, which forms part of the kingdom’s push to [USN:L6N42B0X9 TEXT:"diversify its economy"] beyond oil and expand its global footprint in the leisure industry.
No opening date has been set for what would be one of Europe’s largest theme park developments, with construction expected to take several years.
Bin Salman, who owns a chateau near Paris, is making a rare official trip abroad and appeared alongside Macron at the closing ceremony of the Esports World Cup in Paris on Sunday.
French officials cast the Dragon Ball Z project as evidence that France remains a magnet for foreign investment, though key details for the sprawling development that would include three different theme parks are yet to be settled.
($1 = 0.8571 euros)

items.title: UK, Ukraine sign AI defence partnership linked to battlefield technology
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Britain said on Monday it had signed a partnership with Ukraine to jointly develop artificial intelligence tools for defence and security, giving British researchers access to a Ukrainian battlefield data platform used to train military AI systems.
items.body:
Britain said on Monday it had signed a partnership with Ukraine to jointly develop artificial intelligence tools for defence and security, giving British researchers access to a Ukrainian battlefield data platform used to train military AI systems.
Prime Minister Andy Burnham and President Volodymyr Zelenskiy signed the agreement in Kyiv, making Britain the first international partner to access Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs, a government statement said.
Avengers Labs was built around an annotated dataset of 5 million battlefield images, Ukraine's Defence Ministry said earlier in August, largely drawn from the military's DELTA combat system – a domestically developed battlefield management and situational-awareness system.
The platform uses data collected from cameras and sensors across Ukraine's battlefield, including information on tanks, artillery systems, drones and other military targets.
The Ukrainian ministry said AI models trained on the data were already being used in an automated target-detection system that analyses more than 100,000 drone video feeds each month and can identify about 70% of enemy targets in real time.
Under the deal, Britain and Ukraine will collaborate on pilot projects including technology that uses fibre-optic cables as AI-enabled sensors to help protect military facilities, and research into low-power AI chips for drones and autonomous systems.
The British government said the partnership would initially focus on defence and national security projects bringing together researchers, engineers, technology companies and military experts from both countries.
Burnham on Monday visited Ukraine for his first trip abroad since becoming prime minister, where he had talks with Zelenskiy and co-chaired a meeting of the "Coalition of the Willing."
His office had earlier announced Britain would allow missile maker MBDA to [USN:L4N44K01O TEXT:"release classified information"] on British-made components used in the SCALP long-range cruise missile to help establish assembly lines in Ukraine.

items.title: Bancos defendem que Brasil faça lição de casa para enfrentar mundo mais complexo
items.author: Paula Arend Laier
items.creator: Paula Arend Laier
items.summary: A poucos meses das eleições no Brasil, presidentes de vários dos principais bancos do país defenderam nesta segunda-feira o equilíbrio das contas públicas e uma agenda para melhorar a produtividade, ressaltando um ambiente externo mais complexo.
items.body:
A poucos meses das eleições no Brasil, presidentes de vários dos principais bancos do país defenderam nesta segunda-feira o equilíbrio das contas públicas e uma agenda para melhorar a produtividade, ressaltando um ambiente externo mais complexo.
"O que nós queremos ver efetivamente é equilíbrio fiscal, é um equilíbrio dessa dívida para que ela não suba nessa proporção em relação ao PIB", ressaltou o presidente-executivo do Bradesco , Marcelo Noronha, em painel durante evento de tecnologia no setor financeiro organizado pela federação de bancos, Febraban, em São Paulo. "É preciso haver vontade política para fazer isso", acrescentou o executivo.
A dívida pública bruta do país como proporção do PIB fechou junho em 81,9%, contra 81,0% no mês anterior. Já a dívida líquida do setor público foi a 68,5%, de 67,9%. O Tesouro Nacional projeta que o indicador seguirá em alta até 2029.
Desde que o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva assumiu o cargo, em janeiro de 2023, a dívida bruta do Brasil, considerada o principal indicador da solvência do país, [USN:L1N43X0M1 TEXT:"aumentou"] 10,2 pontos percentuais do PIB.
O presidente-executivo do Itaú Unibanco , Milton Maluhy Filho, afirmou que é preciso olhar a questão do endividamento público. "A trajetória da dívida nesse ritmo é insustentável", afirmou, reforçando que o país deve parar de falar de superávit primário e déficit primário e falar de déficit nominal.
"Com uma dívida de R$10 trilhões com juros a 14%, essa conta no longo prazo é muito complexa, não tem nenhuma economia que resista a um juro real no nível que estamos vivendo", afirmou. Maluhy Filho lembrou que os juros no nível atual prejudicam o principal negócio dos bancos, a concessão de crédito, uma vez que em cenários restritivos com o atual a inadimplência cresce e o setor é forçado a emprestar menos.
O déficit nominal do Brasil subiu para quase 10% do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) nos 12 meses até junho, de acordo com dados divulgados no final de julho pelo Banco Central, atingindo o nível mais alto desde 2021 sob o impacto da conta de juros.
O rombo aumentou para R$1,318 trilhão, o equivalente a 9,99% do PIB, ante 9,61% até maio e 7,27% um ano antes. Na próxima semana, uma atualização dos números vai ser divulgada pelo Banco Central.
O presidente-executivo do Santander Brasil , Gilson Finkelsztain, reforçou o discurso afirmando que o Brasil precisa se ajustar rápido porque o cenário global vai ser mais difícil, em meio a uma "competição por capital" em que outras economias também estão elevando os juros. "Toda esta agenda local precisa ter o dobro de esforço para botar ordem na casa porque o mundo está mais complexo", afirmou.
O presidente-executivo do BTG Pactual , Roberto Sallouti, chamou atenção para questões como custo de capital, governança fiscal e produtividade. "Nós não podemos contar com o crescimento populacional para aumentar o nosso próprio potencial. Nós temos que ganhar produtividade. Educação, uso de tecnologia, infraestrutura e assim por diante", afirmou, destacando a inteligência artificial.
"Nós estamos vivendo uma revolução tecnológica, que primeiro está levando um capex (investimento) enorme que está pressionando os mercados, e depois vai gerar ganhos de produtividade inimagináveis", disse Sallouti.
items.raw_description: A poucos meses das eleições no Brasil, presidentes de vários dos principais bancos do país defenderam nesta segunda-feira o equilíbrio das contas públicas e uma agenda para melhorar a produtividade, ressaltando um ambiente externo mais complexo.

items.title: GRANOS Maíz alcanza máximo en tres años en Chicago, operadores prevén una menor producción en EEUU
items.author: Heather Schlitz
items.creator: Heather Schlitz
items.summary: Los futuros del maíz de Chicago se dispararon el lunes hasta alcanzar máximos de tres años, después de que una visita a la zona productora de maíz y soja de Estados Unidos la semana pasada revelara que la cosecha del cereal se encontraba en peores condiciones de lo que muchos esperaban.
items.body:
Los futuros del maíz de Chicago se dispararon el lunes hasta alcanzar máximos de tres años, después de que una visita a la zona productora de maíz y soja de Estados Unidos la semana pasada revelara que la cosecha del cereal se encontraba en peores condiciones de lo que muchos esperaban.
El trigo alcanzó su nivel más alto en unos dos años, ya que los ataques recíprocos entre Rusia y Ucrania limitaron las exportaciones desde los puertos del Mar Negro. La soja bajó, presionada por la caída del precio del petróleo, pero las pérdidas se vieron limitadas por la fuerte demanda de exportación de soja estadounidense.
El contrato de maíz más activo de la Bolsa de Chicago sumaba 10,25 centavos a 5,1875 dólares por bushel a las 1530 GMT, tras alcanzar los 5,2525 dólares por bushel, su nivel más alto desde 2023. La mayoría de los contratos de maíz registraron máximos históricos.
"El mercado repuntó durante la noche tras los datos del viernes publicados al cierre de la sesión", afirmó Joe Davis, director de ventas de materias primas de Futures International.
El servicio de asesoramiento Pro Farmer estimó el viernes que la producción de maíz de Estados Unidos en 2026 se situará muy por debajo de las previsiones del Gobierno, después de que una gira por siete de los principales estados productores revelara que las cosechas, por debajo de lo habitual, se han visto perjudicadas por las condiciones meteorológicas adversas del verano.
Pro Farmer prevé que los agricultores cosechen 15.344 millones de bushels de maíz, un 9,9% menos que en 2025, pero aún así la tercera cosecha más grande de la historia, con un rendimiento medio de 173,2 bushels por acre. La estimación de rendimiento de Pro Farmer para Estados Unidos, de concretarse, sería la más baja desde 2020.
"La gente se quedó sorprendida al ver esa cifra", dijo Davis.
Los operadores también temen que el fenómeno meteorológico de El Niño reduzca la producción de maíz en Brasil y están preocupados por la capacidad de Ucrania para exportar, según los analistas.
En cuanto a otros cultivos, el trigo de la CBOT subió 4 centavos a 7,03 dólares el bushel tras alcanzar su máximo en aproximadamente dos años. La soja cayó 18 centavos a 12,2150 dólares el bushel.
El trigo se vio sometido a presión el lunes después de que el presidente de Ucrania, Volodímir Zelenski, afirmara que se seguiría una "vía diplomática" con Rusia para debatir la intensificación de los ataques de Moscú en el mar Negro. Las exportaciones de trigo del mar Negro se han visto gravemente reducidas debido a la escalada de ataques en la región.
"Hoy no hay un bloqueo total, pero se está intentando establecerlo. No obstante, entre tres y cuatro barcos al día entran y salen del área metropolitana de Odesa", afirmó Zelenski.
La debilidad de los precios del aceite de soja lastró al complejo de la soja el lunes. El aceite de soja cayó debido al efecto de contagio de la debilidad del petróleo, que bajó más de 1 dólar por barril, ya que los inversionistas recogieron beneficios tras las recientes alzas.

items.title: Report: Patriots sign P Matt Haack
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Patriots signed veteran punter Matt Haack on Monday, according to ESPN.
items.body:
The Patriots signed veteran punter Matt Haack on Monday, according to ESPN.
New England coach Mike Vrabel told reporters that the team would be adding a new punter after Bryce Baringer was forced to exit Saturday's preseason win over the Philadelphia Eagles with an injury.
Haack, 32, was most recently with the Washington Commanders this offseason as a temporary injury replacement for Tress Way before he was released last week. He saw action last season, his ninth in the NFL, for the Arizona Cardinals, punting 25 times over seven games and averaging 51.3 yards per punt and 43.4 net yards per punt.
Haack appeared in 12 games over the last three seasons after serving as a full-time starter for his first six NFL seasons. He has career averages of 45.0 yards per punt and 39.9 net yards per punt over 478 punts across 110 games for the Miami Dolphins (2017-20), Buffalo Bills (2021), Indianapolis Colts (2022), Cleveland Browns (2023), New York Giants (2024) and Cardinals.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Ações ficam estáveis enquanto mercados avaliam tensões no Irã e aguardam dados econômicos
items.author: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Utkarsh Hathi
items.creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Utkarsh Hathi
items.summary: As ações europeias permaneceram estáveis nesta segunda-feira, enquanto os mercados acompanhavam os desdobramentos entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã e se preparavam para uma semana repleta de dados econômicos que podem oferecer novas pistas sobre a trajetória da política monetária do Banco Central Europeu.
items.body:
As ações europeias permaneceram estáveis nesta segunda-feira, enquanto os mercados acompanhavam os desdobramentos entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã e se preparavam para uma semana repleta de dados econômicos que podem oferecer novas pistas sobre a trajetória da política monetária do Banco Central Europeu.
Os investidores se preparavam para os detalhes de possíveis sanções secundárias mais duras dos EUA contra países com laços comerciais com o Irã, que devem ser anunciadas pelo secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent. Separadamente, o chefe do Exército do Paquistão está em Teerã para levar o Irã de volta à mesa de negociações.
“Há muitas incógnitas em torno disso (das sanções) no momento”, disse Chris Beauchamp, analista-chefe de mercado do IG Group.
“Se houver uma situação em que a ação dos EUA seja interpretada como uma ameaça à economia iraniana e eles respondam da única maneira que podem, tomando medidas no Estreito de Ormuz, isso seria particularmente ruim para os mercados europeus.”
O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) fechou inalterado em 654,21 pontos.
Entre os setores, as ações de viagens e lazer lideraram os ganhos, subindo 1,7%, enquanto o petróleo Brent recuou 1,9%.
As ações do setor de mídia (.SXPP) e de bens pessoais e domésticos (.SXQP) tiveram alta de 1,4%.
O índice de referência STOXX 600 recuou nas últimas semanas após atingir máximas históricas neste mês impulsionado por uma alta nos lucros, com as preocupações com a inflação ganhando destaque.
Os mercados monetários estão precificando uma ação mais hawkish por parte do Banco Central Europeu, apostando que as tensões geopolíticas possam manter as pressões sobre os preços elevadas e levar a taxa de depósito para perto de 3% até o final de 2027.
Os investidores também aguardam uma série de divulgações econômicas nesta semana, incluindo dados do PIB alemão e francês, a pesquisa Ifo alemã e os números da inflação espanhola, que podem testar as expectativas de uma postura mais hawkish do BCE em meio à pressão renovada dos preços da energia.
Em LONDRES, o índice Financial Times (.FTSE) avançou 0,35%, a 10.854,32 pontos.
Em FRANKFURT, o índice DAX (.GDAXI) caiu 0,11%, a 26.106,60 pontos.
Em PARIS, o índice CAC-40 (.FCHI) perdeu 0,37%, a 8.453,01 pontos.
Em MILÃO, o índice Ftse/Mib (.FTMIB) teve desvalorização de 0,24%, a 52.542,18 pontos.
Em MADRI, o índice Ibex-35 (.IBEX) registrou alta de 0,69%, a 20.098,60 pontos.
Em LISBOA, o índice PSI20 (.PSI20) valorizou-se 0,40%, a 9.391,96 pontos.

items.title: Brasileña Braskem aprueba una reestructuración extrajudicial por 10.900 millones de dólares
items.author: Luciana Magalhaes
items.creator: Luciana Magalhaes
items.summary: El directorio de la empresa petroquímica brasileña Braskem aprobó solicitar una reestructuración extrajudicial para renegociar unos 10.900 millones de dólares de deuda no garantizada, indicó el lunes en un comunicado al regulador de valores.
items.body:
El directorio de la empresa petroquímica brasileña Braskem aprobó solicitar una reestructuración extrajudicial para renegociar unos 10.900 millones de dólares de deuda no garantizada, indicó el lunes en un comunicado al regulador de valores.
Braskem (BRKM3.SA) , la mayor compañía petroquímica de Latinoamérica, se ha visto afectada por una prolongada recesión en el sector y por una catástrofe relacionada con sus minas de sal en el noreste de Brasil, lo que ha debilitado gravemente su situación de efectivo.
La empresa solicitará la reestructuración extrajudicial una vez que se haya ultimado la documentación pertinente, añadió.
Las acciones de Braskem caían hasta un 4,5 por ciento tras el anuncio, lo que las convirtió en las que peor se comportaron en el índice bursátil de referencia de Brasil, el Bovespa (.BVSP) , que subía un 1 por ciento.
Sin embargo, esta medida no ha sido una sorpresa, dados los problemas de deuda que Braskem arrastra desde hace tiempo, y tras las recientes rebajas de las calificaciones crediticias de la empresa por parte de Fitch y Moody’s.
Reuters informó este mes de que el gigante petroquímico se encontraba en negociaciones avanzadas para solicitar una reestructuración extrajudicial en Brasil antes de finales de agosto, ya que estaba a punto de expirar una protección de emergencia de 60 días.
"Creemos que la noticia ya se esperaba, dado el fin de la medida cautelar que concedía la protección de 60 días", señalaron los analistas de Citi en una nota a sus clientes.
Braskem Idesa, una compañía conjunta entre la firma brasileña y el Grupo Idesa de México, solicitó la semana pasada acogerse al Capítulo 11 de la Ley de Quiebras de Estados Unidos.
La propuesta de reestructuración extrajudicial se elaborará en un plazo de 90 días, informaron a Reuters tres fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto bajo condición de anonimato.
El plan podría incluir una oferta pública de venta de acciones posterior, lo que podría allanar el camino para una ampliación de capital en la que participen inversionistas externos, añadieron las fuentes.
El control de Braskem lo comparten la firma de capital riesgo IG4 Capital, que recientemente adquirió una participación del grupo de ingeniería Novonor, y la petrolera estatal Petrobras (PETR3.SA) .
Los analistas de UBS BB señalaron que una resolución definitiva del proceso de reestructuración de la empresa podría llevar tiempo, pero la ausencia de una inyección de capital inmediata reduce, por el momento, el riesgo de dilución para los accionistas.
Braskem señaló que el procedimiento extrajudicial se limitaba a la reestructuración de sus pasivos financieros y no afectaría a las obligaciones con proveedores, clientes u otras partes interesadas.

items.title: Steelers activate CB Jalen Ramsey (knee) from PUP list
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers activated eight-time Pro Bowl cornerback Jalen Ramsey from the physically unable to perform list on Monday.
items.body:
The Pittsburgh Steelers activated eight-time Pro Bowl cornerback Jalen Ramsey from the physically unable to perform list on Monday.
Ramsey, 31, sustained a knee injury during the team's minicamp but did not require surgery.
Also cleared to return to the practice field is rookie offensive lineman Max Iheanachor, the first-round pick who has been sidelined since sustaining a neck/shoulder injury on Aug. 6.
Ramsey was dealt to Pittsburgh last summer in a swap that sent safety Minkah Fitzpatrick back to Miami. He recorded 88 tackles, three sacks and one interception in 17 regular-season games with the Steelers.
He has totaled 622 tackles and 25 interceptions in 152 career regular-season games (151 starts) with the Jacksonville Jaguars (2016-19), Los Angeles Rams (2019-22), Dolphins (2023-24) and Steelers since being drafted fifth overall in 2016.
The Steelers play their final preseason game Thursday night at Buffalo and open the regular season at home against Atlanta on Sept. 13.
--Field Level Media

items.title: La "guerre de Trump" à l'origine de la flambée des taux obligataires - ministre allemand
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La récente flambée des taux obligataires est le résultat de "la guerre menée par le président américain Donald Trump en Iran", a déclaré lundi le ministre allemand des Finances Lars Klingbeil, lors d'une conférence de presse à Schaan, au Liechtenstein.
items.body:
La récente flambée des taux obligataires est le résultat de "la guerre menée par le président américain Donald Trump en Iran", a déclaré lundi le ministre allemand des Finances Lars Klingbeil, lors d'une conférence de presse à Schaan, au Liechtenstein.
"La hausse des taux d'intérêt observée ces derniers jours et ces dernières semaines est le résultat de l'incertitude mondiale déclenchée par la guerre de Donald Trump contre l'Iran", a-t-il déclaré aux côtés des ministres des Finances d'autres pays germanophones.
Le rendement de l'obligation d'État allemande à 30 ans a atteint la semaine dernière son plus haut niveau depuis 2011, à 3,79%, en raison notamment des craintes d'inflation entretenues par l'impasse prolongée au Moyen-Orient, où les Etats-Unis et Israël ont déclenché une guerre contre l'Iran le 28 février.
En guise de représailles à cette attaque, l'Iran avait rapidement fermé de facto le détroit d'Ormuz, voie essentielle au transport maritime mondiale d'hydrocarbures.
Ceci s'était traduit par une flambée des cours du pétrole, qui restent à un niveau élevé, à plus de 90 dollars le baril, en raison de l'absence de tout progrès vers une résolution du conflit, les deux belligérants, qui clament tous deux contrôler le détroit d'Ormuz, brandissant au contraire la menace d'une escalade.

items.title: POINT MARCHÉS L'Europe termine sur une note prudente, en attendant des annonces américaines
items.author: Coralie Lamarque
items.creator: Coralie Lamarque
items.summary: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en baisse mardi, dans l'attente de précisions de la part des États-Unis sur plusieurs catalyseurs aussi bien géopolitiques que macroéconomiques.
items.body:
Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en baisse mardi, dans l'attente de précisions de la part des États-Unis sur plusieurs catalyseurs aussi bien géopolitiques que macroéconomiques.
À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) a perdu 0,37% à 8.453,01 points. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) a reculé de 0,11% tandis qu'à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) a pris 0,35%.
L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) a reculé de de 0,22%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) a grappillé 0,03%, tandis que le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) a terminé stable.
Le conflit entre l'Iran et les États-Unis continue de tenir en haleine les marchés, les investisseurs se tenant prêts pour la conférence de presse prévue à 17h00 GMT du secrétaire américain au Trésor, Scott Bessent, au sujet de nouvelles sanctions américaines contre l'Iran et dites sans précédent.
Ces annonces pourraient jeter une ombre de plus sur les perspectives pétrolières et inflationnistes des marchés, en amont du discours du président de la Réserve fédérale américaine, Kevin Warsh, lors de la conférence de Jackson Hole qui débute cette semaine, qui [USN:L6N44L0DY TEXT:"suscitera"] également l'intérêt des opérateurs.
En plus du Moyen-Orient et de la politique monétaire, les yeux des investisseurs restent rivés sur Washington, le président américain Donald Trump menaçant d'imposer des droits de douane de 50% sur les véhicules produits au Canada.
VALEURS Lanterne rouge du CAC 40, Stellantis a perdu 4,41%, alors que la [USN:L6N44L0QL TEXT:"menace"] du président américain Donald Trump de porter à 50% les droits de douane sur les véhicules produits au Canada nuit aux grands groupes automobiles.
Dans le sillage de nouvelles sanctions américaines prévues contre l'Iran, le compartiment des énergies fossiles (.SXEP) a perdu 1,57%, enregistrant de loin la pire performance sectorielle de la séance.
À WALL STREET À l'heure de la clôture en Europe, le Dow Jones (.DJI) avance de 0,42%, tandis que le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) cède 0,09% et que le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recule de 0,36%.
CHANGES Le billet vert progresse après avoir enregistré sa troisième baisse hebdomadaire sur les quatre dernières semaines, alors que le Trésor américain s'est engagé à racheter davantage d'obligations à long terme et que l'incertitude concernant de nouvelles sanctions américaines contre l'Iran bénéficie aux valeurs refuge.
Le dollar gagne 0,18% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tandis que l'euro perd 0,11% à 1,1666 dollar .
TAUX Alors que le média CNBC a rapporté que le Trésor américain pourrait puiser dans son compte de trésorerie pour financer une augmentation des rachats de dette, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans perd 3,8 points de base à 4,7001%, tandis que le deux ans grappille 0,6 point de base à 4,2401%.
En Europe, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans a pris 0,7 point de base à 3,2532% et le deux ans a progressé de 0,9 point de base à 2,8632%.
PÉTROLE Les cours pétroliers sont en baisse, sur fond de prises de bénéfices après les récentes hausses et avant des précisions sur les nouvelles sanctions américaines attendues contre l'Iran, qui pourraient perturber davantage les approvisionnements en provenance du Moyen-Orient.
Le Brent perd 2,09% à 92,40 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) lâche 2,65% à 84,75 dollars.
À SUIVRE MARDI 25 AOÛT : [USN:L8N43Q1NY]
LA SITUATION SUR LES MARCHÉS (Certaines données peuvent accuser un léger décalage)

items.title: Japan did not ban mosques - its constitution guarantees religious freedom
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Online posts saying Japan has introduced “anti-Islam laws” that ban mosques, burqas, halal food and the Islamic call to prayer are false. The government has not brought in any such laws and Japan's constitution guarantees religious freedom.
items.body:
Online posts saying Japan has introduced “anti-Islam laws” that ban mosques, burqas, halal food and the Islamic call to prayer are false. The government has not brought in any such laws and Japan's constitution guarantees religious freedom.
Here are the key details:
The posts from August said the so-called laws were “basically saying Islam is not welcome” in Japan.
A spokesperson for Japan’s Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology told Reuters that was “not true at all”.
The spokesperson said religious freedom is enshrined in Japan’s constitution and that no regulations have been introduced to purposely prohibit halal food, mosques, burqas or the call to prayer.
Article 20 of the Constitution of Japan says: “Freedom of religion is guaranteed to all.”
Mosques are mostly found in Japan’s larger cities, according to the J apanese National Tourism Organization , which recommends a mosque-finder website on its website.
The JNTO says there has been a boost in “halal travel” to Japan and attributes that to an increase in Muslim-friendly and halal-accredited restaurants and facilities, mosques and tours.
Verdict: False. Japan’s constitution guarantees religious freedom for all. A culture ministry spokesperson said there are no regulations that prohibit the practices listed in the online posts.
This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more  about our fact-checking work.
items.raw_description: Online posts saying Japan has introduced “anti-Islam laws” that ban mosques, burqas, halal food and the Islamic call to prayer are false. The government has not brought in any such laws and Japan's constitution guarantees religious freedom.

After weeks of speculation, the IFA made the announcement at a press conference attended by the 63-year-old, confirming he would remain in charge through the Gulf Cup in Saudi Arabia in September, as well as the Asian Cup early next year.
"I have renewed my contract for six months and this decision is in my best interest and in the best interest of the Iraq national team, although the association offered me a four-year extension," Arnold was quoted as saying by the Iraqi News Agency.
Arnold guided Iraq to this year's World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico, ending a 40-year absence from the tournament. However, Iraq exited at the group stage after losing all of their Group I matches against Norway, France and Senegal.

O presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que haverá uma “via diplomática” com a Rússia para discutir a intensificação dos ataques de Moscou no Mar Negro, que têm prejudicado a capacidade de exportação da Ucrânia.

items.title: 中国国家主席、7年ぶりインド訪問へ　ＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議に大規模代表団
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Saurabh Sharma　Aftab Ahmed

[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Saurabh Sharma　Aftab Ahmed

[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席が、９月にインドで開催される新興国グループ「ＢＲＩＣＳ」首脳会議に大規模な代表団を率いて出席する見通しだと、関係者３人が明らかにした。実現すれば７年ぶりの訪問となり、中国とインドの関係改善につながる可能性がある。

ＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議は９月１２、１３両日にニューデリーで開催。２０２０年の両国国境付近での衝突を受けて悪化した関係の修復につながるかどうかが注目される。トランプ米政権の通商政策を踏まえ、ＢＲＩＣＳ諸国の経済への悪影響を抑えたい意向とみられる。

インド関係者の１人はロイターに「中国当局者は、宿泊や警備体制の最終調整をしている」と述べた。関係者２人によると、約４００人の中国当局者が同行する見通し。１９年の前回訪問時は２００人未満だった。

関係者らによると、両国の当局者らは首脳による協議で、国境や地域の安全保障問題を巡る長年の対立を調整しつつ、関係拡大へ向けた方法を模索するとみられる。習氏の最終的な訪問計画や二国間会談に関する議題などは未確定という。

インドのモディ首相は昨年、７年ぶりに中国を訪問したものの、両国関係に大きな改善は見られていない。インドのアジト・ドバル国家安全保障顧問は２４日から訪中し、王毅外相と国境問題に関して協議する見通しだ。

中国外務省は「今年のＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議が成功するよう支援する」とした上で、習氏の訪問に関して「現時点で提供できる情報はない」と述べた。２５年にブラジルで開かれた前回のＢＲＩＣＳサミットでは、習氏は出席を見送っていた。

China's Xi likely to visit India with big delegation for first time in seven years

India-China relations have remained strained for years, largely due to ongoing border tensions and territorial disputes.

Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi meet on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in Kazan, Russia, on Oct 23, 2024. (Photo: REUTERS/China Daily)

FAST

NEW DELHI: Chinese President Xi Jinping is likely to attend next month's BRICS summit in New Delhi with a large delegation , three sources said, in what would be his first visit in seven years and a fresh sign of a thaw between the rivals.
India is hosting the Sep 12 to 13 summit, where Xi 's presence would be watched less for the BRICS agenda than for what it signals about Beijing and New Delhi's efforts to stabilise relations after deadly border clashes in 2020 .
"Chinese officials are busy finalising hotels and security protocols," one of the India n sources with direct knowledge told Reuters.
Last year, India n Prime Minister Narendra Modi visit ed China for the first time in seven years , but the relationship has only improved gradually. More recently, a fresh border-related dispute triggered sharp diplomatic exchanges between the two sides.

Two other India n sources said Xi was likely to be accompanied by a delegation of about 400 officials, compared with fewer than 200 officials the last time in 2019.
Officials from both countries are expected to use the summit to explore ways to expand engagement while managing long-standing differences over the border and regional security issues, the sources added.
Xi 's final travel plans and agenda for any potential bilateral between India and China are yet to be finalised , the sources said.
The Chinese foreign ministry said, "China attaches great importance to and actively participates in BRICS cooperation, and supports India , the current chair, in successfully hosting this year's BRICS summit."
"We currently have no information available to provide" about Xi 's visit , it said. Xi missed the last BRICS summit in 2025 in Brazil.
India 's foreign ministry did not comment.

INDIA -CHINA BORDER ISSUE The world's two most populous nations, both nuclear powers, share a roughly 3,800-km (2,400-mile), largely undemarcated and disputed border in the Himalayas.
Decades of relative peace along the border were shattered by 2020 clashes where 20 India n and four Chinese soldiers were killed. The incident led to a four-year military standoff before reaching a disengagement pact in October 2024.
But on Aug 12, India said peace along the border was critical to ties after reports that India n and Chinese army patrols came face-to-face in late July near a remote border.
India 's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval on Monday (Aug 24) started his visit to Beijing to meet Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi to hold talks on the boundary issue.
While India and China remain competitors, US President Donald Trump's trade policies have created one area of convergence, making Xi 's attendance a signal that neither side wants external pressure to undermine BRICS.

items.title: LinkedIn Users Are Rewriting the Past to Land Jobs
items.summary:
Researchers at Stanford University and Revelio Labs found that nearly 20% of established US LinkedIn users edited the descriptions or titles of jobs they had left years earlier, with tech workers doing so at a rate of nearly one in three.
These changes, dubbed "time travel," aren't made while memories are still fresh, but instead reflect a change in personal branding, with the median time-travel edit occurring more than four years after the user left the role. Beth Kowitt, Bloomberg Opinion Columnist covering corporate America joined Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

FAST

JOHANNESBURG, Aug 24 : South Africa coach Rassie Erasmus wants his team to turn the hurt of their weekend defeat by New Zealand into fuel to get themselves back into contention in the four-test series.
The Springboks lost their top world ranking when New Zealand won the opening test 33-16 at Ellis Park on Saturday, outscoring their hosts five tries to one as they saw off South Africa’s efforts to muscle them into submission.
The world champions had been favourites before the start of the first test of the Kiwis’ eight-match tour.
"One could see the hurt on everyone’s faces after Saturday’s match, and we know what we have to do to bounce back strongly this week," Erasmus said as he announced the line-up for the second test in Cape Town on Saturday.

"There were a handful of positives and negatives last week, but the main thing that let us down was that we created so many chances, but mistakes at crucial times cost us," Erasmus told reporters on Monday.
"We are angry with each other. The coaches did and said stupid things. The players did stupid things on the pitch," added Erasmus.
"Me personally, I made wrong calls on some of the tactics we wanted to try and do inside their 22. It didn’t work and that’s on me."
Erasmus went back to naming his side early, but kept the All Blacks guessing by putting flanker Siya Kolisi back in the side if the inspirational captain proves his fitness. If not, Paul de Villiers will stay in the starting line-up.
"Paul played well on Saturday, and there’s no reason why we should keep him out, but Siya is our captain," the coach said.
"Siya has got some strengths, one of them being the attacking breakdown, he’s really good at sorting that out for us, which was the area we struggled with.
"There were lots of times that we played badly, not because they did anything illegal, but we couldn’t get the ball away out of the breakdown when we were in really good attacking positions. Siya’s really good at that," Erasmus added.

(Writing by Mark Gleeson in Cape Town; Editing by Ed Osmond)

items.title: Gang attack on hillside town near Haiti's capital leaves 30 dead
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday.
items.body:
At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday.
Kenscoff is a hillside town overlooking Port-au-Prince has seen frequent gang attacks over the last couple of years. Rights groups have reported mass killings, rapes, arson and kidnappings, forcing thousands to flee their homes.
Haitian rights group RNDDH estimated 30 to 40 people had been killed and 15 to 20 wounded in the overnight raid, which began around 10:30 p.m. local time (0230 GMT), but warned it was still difficult to assess a complete tally.
Haiti's prime minister's office on Monday afternoon decried the "heinous attack", noting all security forces were on high alert and reinforcements were being deployed.
"Kenscoff will not be abandoned," it said in a statement. "The government's authority will be restored, without weakness and without delay, throughout all of Kenscoff."
Haiti's national police did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The community occupies a strategic position overlooking routes into Petion-Ville - home to several embassies, upscale hotels and the temporary seat of government - as well as routes from the capital into southern parts of the country.
Local media said several houses were set on fire, including the home of Jean William Pape, a leading public health expert in Haiti.
The attack occurred as the U.N.-backed Gang Suppression Force, which is mandated to help police fight gangs and replace an underfunded and ineffectual predecessor, plans to reach a full capacity of more than 5,500 troops by fall this year.

items.title: 49ers owner Jed York pleads no contest after arrest in Ohio
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to reduced charges in Ohio on Monday after reaching an agreement with prosecutors following his Sunday arrest on suspicion of engaging in prostitution.
items.body:
San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to reduced charges in Ohio on Monday after reaching an agreement with prosecutors following his Sunday arrest on suspicion of engaging in prostitution.
In a plea deal entered Monday, prosecutors amended the original charge to misdemeanor disorderly conduct and possessing criminal tools. According to reports, the criminal tool in York's possession was believed to be a cell phone used to reply to a prostitution advertisement.
York, 46, was arrested in East Palestine. Court documents indicate agents for the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force intercepted communication in which York responded to a prostitution website.
York, like other NFL owners, is subject to the league's personal conduct policy. The NFL had not commented on the matter as of Monday afternoon.
As part of the reduced charges, York was sentenced to one day in the Columbiana County Jail for each count.
He was credited with time served Sunday and paid a fine of $1,150, according to court records.
York, a native of Youngstown, Ohio, has been CEO of the 49ers since December 2008 and the team's principal owner since 2024.

items.title: Mark Carney sensibly avoids stepping in fertilizer
items.author: Gabriel Rubin
items.creator: Gabriel Rubin
items.summary: Canada's prime minister rejected the latest US trade proposal, prompting fresh tariff talk. Ontario also wants exports like potash and oil cut off, which would seriously escalate the clash. Waiting out President Trump while pursuing more deals in Asia and beyond is better policy.
items.body:
The United States and its neighbor to the north will share the longest land-border in the world even after President Donald Trump leaves office in 2029. It's an immutable restraint on Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's leverage in a [USN:L1N44J034 TEXT:"trade war"], but also a lasting benefit. After rejecting the latest U.S. proposal, plodding patience is shrewder than extreme pressure.
The White House, naturally, responded to the weekend's breakdown in negotiations with 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods. Carney, who called U.S. demands "uneconomic" and "unfair" vowed to return the favor "dollar for dollar," prompting Trump to threaten to extend 50% tariffs onto all of the country's inbound cars, trucks and automotive parts.
In Carney's interpretation, Trump wants to restrict Canada's ability to trade with other countries and unspecified demands related to Canadian culture, language and sovereignty. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Canada may have rejected the deal “perhaps for political reasons.”
Canada has a nuclear option, one that leaders in Ontario and other provinces are ready to trigger. They want to cut off U.S. access to fertilizer and energy from the Great White North. About 85% of U.S. potash, essential in farming, comes from Canada, as does about 4 million barrels of oil daily, 60% of U.S. imports. Doing so would make it clearer that dependencies go both ways and heap additional economic pressure on Trump.
The risks are greater than the rewards, however. Commodities, in particular, depend on supplier reliability. Once new providers are found, the business doesn’t tend to come back. U.S. [USN:L6N3WB0VG TEXT:"soybeans"] are instructive. Once they became leverage in the trade war with China, purchase agreements for U.S. farmers dried up. Even after a truce was struck, Beijing agreed to buy just 12 million metric tons from the United States last year, less than half as many as in 2024.
Slow and steady is the better approach. Carney has good reasons to snub any limitations on Canada’s ability to trade unfettered with other countries. His top job is to dilute the 70% U.S. share of exports, as he has been doing with energy in India, China, and the EU. Carney's popularity at home affords him time and political capital, while Trump's mid-30s approval rating as midterm elections approach boosts the chances for U.S. policy revisions. There's no reason to step in fertilizer.
Follow Gabriel Rubin on Bluesky and LinkedIn .
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on August 22 rejected a U.S. trade proposal, saying it was "a bad deal."
U.S. President Donald Trump responded by imposing 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods, with Carney vowing to retaliate "dollar for dollar."
Trump subsequently warned on August 24 that U.S. tariffs on all Canadian cars, trucks and automotive parts would be increased to 50% starting on January 1.

items.title: 政府、非中核事業の売却益で課税繰り延べ検討　事業再編を促進＝関係者
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Miho Uranaka　Makiko Yamazaki

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Miho Uranaka　Makiko Yamazaki

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 政府は、企業が非中核事業の売却益を成長事業の買収に充てることを条件に、課税を無期限に先送りできる新しい税制の導入を検討している。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が明らかにした。８月末の税制改正要望への盛り込みを経て、年末に策定する２０２７年度税制改正大綱への反映を目指す。企業の事業ポートフォリオの組み替えや成長投資を促すのが狙いで、長年滞っていた企業の事業再編が加速する可能性がある。

関係者によると、この案では、企業が子会社の株式や事業の売却により得た資金を数年以内に中核事業に関連する買収へ再投資し、さらに買収後の事業への投資も確約することを条件に、売却益にかかる約３０％の法人税を無期限に繰り延べることができる。買収後の再投資は、賃上げや設備投資などの成長投資も条件となる見通し。売却から買収までの期間など、詳細は今後詰める。

売却益への課税は次の買収に回せる資金を目減りさせ、事業入れ替えの足かせとなっていた。政府は、企業が低収益事業を売却し得られた資金を中核事業の強化に回す循環をつくりたい考えで、高市早苗首相が進めるガバナンス改革を加速させる上でも重要な施策の一つとなる可能性がある。

背景には、多くの企業が低収益事業を抱え続け、資本を成長分野に振り向けられていないとの政府の問題意識がある。経済産業省のデータによると、投下資本のうち資本コストを上回る価値を生む部門への配分は３５％にとどまる。２０２０年の報告書では、日本企業は事業売却の基準を持たず、規模や雇用の安定を優先してきたと指摘している。

政府はこれまでもスピンオフ税制（１７年）やパーシャル・スピンオフ税制（２３年）など企業再編を後押しする措置を導入したが、活用実績は限られている。今回の案は、２０００年代初頭にドイツで実施され、株式売却益の原則非課税化で企業の持ち合い解消と事業再編を促した税制改革を参考にした。

政府はコーポレート・ガバナンス改革を通じ、企業に事業ポートフォリオの見直しや経営資源の配分について、具体的な説明と継続的な検証を求めている。同時に事業ポートフォリオの改善や事業再編を促す「強力なインセンティブ措置」を検討するとしていた。今回の税制は、こうした改革の中核をなす施策と位置付けられる。

日本のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）件数は過去最高水準に達する一方、資本や人材が生産性の高い企業へ移る質的な再編は進んでいない。ロンドン証券取引所グループ（ＬＳＥＧ）によると、昨年、日本企業が関与したＭ＆Ａ総額は前年比２倍超の約３５２９億ドルで過去最高となり、このうち日本企業による事業売却は４４７億ドルだった。

items.title: Japan eyes tax breaks for non-core business sales in governance reform push, sources say
items.author: Makiko Yamazaki, Miho Uranaka
items.creator: Makiko Yamazaki, Miho Uranaka
items.summary: Japan's government is considering tax breaks on gains from sales of non-core businesses, a move that could accelerate long-delayed corporate restructuring and spur industry consolidation, two people with knowledge of the matter said.
items.body:
Japan's government is considering tax breaks on gains from sales of non-core businesses, a move that could accelerate long-delayed corporate restructuring and spur industry consolidation, two people with knowledge of the matter said.
The plan would remove a major obstacle to companies shedding non-core businesses and redeploying capital into growth areas, in what could become one of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's most significant initiatives to advance corporate governance reform.
Under the plan, roughly 30% corporate tax on gains from sales of non-core businesses would be deferred indefinitely, provided companies reinvest the proceeds within several years in acquisitions aligned with their core operations and commit to investing in those businesses, one of the sources said.
The proposal is expected to be submitted as part of tax reform requests due at the end of this month, with details to be worked out before a final tax reform package for the next fiscal year is approved at year-end, said one of the sources, who declined to be identified as the matter is still private.
POOR CAPITAL ALLOCATION The initiative is modelled on Germany's tax reform in the early 2000s, which largely exempted corporations from taxes on gains from share disposals, helping dismantle the country's dense network of cross-shareholdings and making it easier for companies to reshape their business portfolios.
Non-core businesses often remain trapped within sprawling Japanese conglomerates because gains from divestitures are taxed, reducing the incentive to transfer assets to owners better positioned to extract value from them.
The result is often inefficient capital allocation. A recent government study found that about 65% of Japanese companies' invested capital remains tied up in businesses that fail to earn their cost of capital, largely offsetting value created by higher-performing units.
Such capital trapped in low-return operations is seen as limiting growth investment and weighing on long-term corporate value.
Japan has already introduced a range of measures to promote business overhauls over the years, including spin-off tax rules in 2017 and a partial spin-off regime in 2023, but business divestitures taking advantage of those rules have remained relatively limited.
A 2020 industry ministry report showed Japanese companies often lack clear divestment criteria and have traditionally prioritised maintaining group size, employment and corporate stability over portfolio reshaping.
The tax reform, if implemented, is likely to boost already sizzling M&A activity in Japan.
Deal activity involving Japanese companies last year more than doubled from the previous year to a record $353 billion, according to LSEG. Divestitures of Japanese businesses accounted for $44.7 billion of that total.

Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２４日 ロイター] - ドイツのクリンバイル財務相は２４日、最近の債券利回りの急上昇はトランプ米大統領による「イラン戦争」の結果だとの認識を示した。リヒテンシュタインのシャーンで開かれた記者会見で述べた。

クリンバイル氏はドイツ語圏諸国の他の財務相らと行った会見で、「ここ数日、数週間にわたる利回りの上昇は、トランプ氏のイラン戦争によって引き起こされた世界的な不確実性の結果だ」と述べた。

ドイツの３０年国債利回りは先週、２０１１年以来の高水準となる３．７９％を記録。米３０年債利回りは１８日、５．３２１％に達し、０７年以来の高水準を付けた。イラン戦争に伴うインフレ懸念は、国債の売り圧力に拍車をかけている。

こうした中、関係筋は２４日、ロイターに対し、米政府は各国に対し、イランとの関係を断たなければ、ドル建て金融システムから自国の企業が排除される恐れがあると警告する方針だと明らかにした。

items.title: Vuelta third stage abandoned after hailstorm in Pyrenees
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A torrential hailstorm in the French Pyrenees forced the abandonment of the third stage of the Vuelta a Espana on Monday.
items.body:
A torrential hailstorm in the French Pyrenees forced the abandonment of the third stage of the Vuelta a Espana on Monday.
With 15 km (9.32 miles) remaining of the 174-km route from Gruissan to Font-Romeu, the skies darkened as the peloton neared the top of the Col de Mont-Louis and huge hailstones began bouncing off the tarmac and pelting the riders.
Mats Wenzel (Kern Pharma) and Lorenzo Fortunato (XDS Astana) were 25 seconds ahead of the peloton when the elements intervened as race leader and favourite Tadej Pogacar was seen indicating to the peloton to pull off the course.
Bedraggled riders were then seen getting off their bikes and shuffling into a hotel for shelter.
Shortly afterwards race organisers ASO announced the stage would not resume, leaving fans frustrated at the finish where thick layers of hail blanketed the road.
Slovenia's Pogacar (UAE Emirates-XRG) retained his overall lead of nine seconds from Belgium's Wout van Aert (Dutch Visma-Lease a Bike) with Britain's Matt Brennan 10 seconds back.
Earlier it had been warm and sunny on the flat approaches to the mountainous finish with no sign of the chaos to come as a five-man breakaway group stayed out ahead.
Pogacar, bidding to complete his Grand Tour collection by winning the Vuelta for the first time, was always near the front of the pack with his team setting the pace.
Sadly, his expected challenge for the stage victory fell foul of the weather in an anti-climactic finish.
He will get his chance to underline his superiority again on Tuesday though with stage four featuring three first-category climbs as the race starts and finishes in Andorra la Vella.

items.title: 米国が中国製品に7.5%関税へ､過剰生産能力で－9月の米中首脳会談前に
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国は中国の過剰生産能力を問題視し、中国製品に対して7.5%の関税を課す見通しだ。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が明らかにしたもので、来月予定されるトランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席との会談を前に導入する方向だ。

今回の措置により、トランプ政権2期目に導入される対中関税は約20%に戻ることになる。これとは別に、トランプ政権1期目に導入され、バイデン政権下でも継続された関税も課されている。

匿名を条件に語った同関係者によれば、具体的な税率は最終決定されたわけではない。トランプ氏は通商政策の発表に関し、最終段階で新たな要求を突き付ける、あるいは内容を変更するといった手法を採ることで知られる。

検討されている案の一つは、より高い対中関税率を発表した上で、その適用を一部停止し、実効税率を7.5%にするものだという。

どの税率をどの程度の期間、適用停止とするか、詳細はなお協議中だと関係者は語った。

トランプ政権は今年3月、過剰生産能力を巡る懸念を理由に、1974年通商法301条に基づき、主要な貿易相手国・地域を対象に調査を開始した。

items.title: India, China Walk a Delicate Borderline in Preparation for BRICS Summit
items.author: Arthur Kaufman
items.creator: Arthur Kaufman
items.summary: India’s National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is visiting Beijing on Monday and Tuesday  this week and will meet Wang Yi as part of the 25th round of talks between each country’s Special Representatives on the border issue. The visit comes a few weeks before a …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
India’s National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is visiting Beijing on Monday and Tuesday  this week and will meet Wang Yi as part of the 25th round of talks between each country’s Special Representatives on the border issue.

The visit comes a few weeks before a BRICS summit in New Delhi on September 12 and 13 that Xi Jinping is expected to attend. It would mark Xi’s first visit to India in seven years and potentially confirm the thaw in relations between India and China.

However, recent news related to their border has complicated  efforts to improve the bilateral relationship .

On August 7,  New Delhi published a controversial new map  that renamed 27 locations in Arunachal Pradesh, referred to as Zangnan or South Tibet by the Chinese, along the Line of Actual Control. This occurred just one day after a meeting between officials from both sides under the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination on border affairs.

The South China Morning Post also published an article on Sunday highlighting  China’s plans to build a vast, 25,000-kilometer “national ring road” along its borders , including the southwestern G219 highway whose upgrades and extensions are taking place in areas disputed by New Delhi.

Despite pushing for warmer relations, India is also seeking to increase its economic independence from China in certain areas. Reuters reported last Friday that, according to government sources,  India is set to approve a $1.2 billion incentive scheme  for producing high-value construction and infrastructure equipment to reduce dependence on China for critical machinery. 

In other news, a cargo ship carrying 24 crew members, 20 of whom are Chinese nationals,  sank off of India’s eastern coast on Sunday . India’s coastguard has so far rescued two Chinese nationals as search-and-rescue operations continue.

WHY IS THIS IMPORTANT?  The Indian and Chinese governments are trying to maintain a delicate diplomatic balancing act. Their move toward better diplomatic ties and a successful BRICS summit with Xi’s attendance requires toning down longstanding disagreements over border issues, while not appearing to capitulate to the other side in the eyes of their respective domestic constituents.

items.title: 米トランプ政権、専門職ビザ手数料10万ドル超へ　規制案公表
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Daniel Wiessner

[２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Daniel Wiessner

[２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権は２４日、専門技能を持つ外国人労働者向け就労ビザ「Ｈ－１Ｂ」の申請手数料を約１０万ドルとする措置を法制化するための規制案を公表した。

トランプ大統領は昨年９月、移民取り締まり強化の一環として、同ビザの手数料引き上げに向けた大統領布告に署名。従来の手数料である約２０００─５０００ドルから１０万ドル超へと大幅に引き上げる内容。

ただ、連邦地裁は６月、議会の承認を得ていない違法な課税に当たるとして、無効とする判断を示し、その後控訴審での審理が続いている。

布告は９月に失効するものの、国土安全保障省に手数料増額を恒久化するための規則を制定するよう指示していた。

同省がオンライン官報に掲載した規制案によると、手数料は１０万３２６５ドルに引き上げられ、２５日に正式に公表される。その後、３０日間のパブリックコメント期間を経て、年末までに最終決定される可能性がある。

items.title: Browns to open season with Deshaun Watson as QB1
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
items.body:
New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
"Took in the full body of work over the course of offseason to training camp to the games and the joint practice, and ultimately, felt like to start the season on the road, Deshaun gave us the best chance to move the ball and score points," Monken said Monday. "And that's really what it's about. I felt that way going into the last game, but wasn't sure. And after we talked as a staff and after we re-looked at everything, we're going to let it rip."
Watson and Shedeur Sanders competed for the starting job in training camp, rotating reps with the first-team offense in practice and preseason games.
The Browns begin the 2026 regular season with two road games: Sept. 13 at the Jacksonville Jaguars and the following week at Tampa Bay. Cleveland's first home game is Sept. 27 against the Carolina Panthers.
Despite reports the Browns were considering holding Sanders in the backup role until the home opener, Monken said Monday he's not entering into a "week-to-week thing" and expects Watson to excel.
"Again, I think Shedeur has done a great job, come a long ways, and we're excited about his future. But this is not a week-to-week decision," he said.
Cleveland covets stability at the position, and Watson was viewed as the potential answer when he was acquired from the Houston Texans prior to the 2022 season. As part of the trade, Watson signed a five-year, $230 million contract. But after starting his tenure with the team serving a suspension, he has been hindered by injuries and is just 9-10 as a starter in Cleveland. He hasn't played more than seven games in any of his four seasons with the Browns.
Watson did not play last season while recovering from two surgeries to repair his Achilles. Watson tore his right Achilles tendon in October 2024 and a recurrence of the same injury during rehab prompted a second operation.
Sanders, a fifth-round pick in 2025, was thrown into the lineup as a rookie. With Watson on injured reserve all season, the Browns began the season with Joe Flacco as the starter but traded him to the Cincinnati Bengals. Dillon Gabriel, a third-round rookie in 2025, was named the starter but Sanders took over in November. He had seven touchdown passes and 10 interceptions in eight games.
Watson likely needs a strong start to the regular season to win back a fan base that appears to be running out of patience. Watson was showered with boos by home fans during Saturday's preseason game and said it was "personal." He played the second half against Buffalo and completed 5 of 12 passes for 36 yards and an interception
"It's a little bit (more) personal than that. So I think it's a disrespectful thing," Watson said of being booed at home. "So yeah, I mean, I'm going to keep whatever I feel with me and my family internally on how I feel about that. And yeah, just move on."
Watson turns 31 the day after the Week 1 opener.
Monken, hired to replace Kevin Stefanski, is a first-time head coach after serving as the Baltimore Ravens' offensive coordinator for the last three seasons. He said Watson and the Browns can avoid being booed at home by playing better, but also offered his perspective on Watson's response.
"I see the competitor in him. I see the everyday work he puts in, and he wants to be back," Monken said. "He wants to get back to where he was as best he can, and that's hard. And again, I think the moment just got him after the game, and it can get all of us."
--Field Level Media

items.title: 9月の相次ぐ社債発行、消化への懸念は行き過ぎ－JPモルガン
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 投資適格級社債市場では、9月に社債発行が相次ぐ見通しだ。JPモルガン・アセット・マネジメントのポートフォリオマネジャー、ケルシー・ベロ氏は、ブルームバーグテレビジョンとのインタビューで、社債への旺盛な需要を踏まえれば、大量発行への懸念は行き過ぎの可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ベロ氏によると、9月の発行額については、1750億－2500億ドル（約27兆8400億－39兆7700億円）と幅広い予想が出ている。クレジットのポートフォリオマネジャーからは、発行額が2500億ドルに達しても「実際にはそれほど問題ではない」との声が聞かれるという。ただ、ベロ氏は、最終的な発行額を巡る不確実性が、市場関係者にとって事前の対応を難しくしていると指摘した。

市場では予想のばらつき自体が緊張の要因となっている。発行額予想の下限と上限には750億ドルの開きがあり、例年、社債発行が最も活発になる月の一つである9月を前に、ポートフォリオマネジャーはポジションを取りにくくなっている。

AIインフラ整備への支出を賄うため企業の借り入れが膨らむ中、社債発行は過去最速のペースが続いている。米国の優良企業による社債発行額は8月、3カ月連続で月間最高を更新した。

借り入れ急増の影響が表れる中、投資家は購入する債券やその価格を以前より厳しく選別するようになっている。データセンター事業の資金調達を目指す企業の中には、投資適格級の債券であっても、数十億ドルを調達するためにジャンク債投資家への依存を強めるところも出ている。

8月の社債発行額はすでに1570億ドルに達した。アルファベットによる250億ドルの起債に加え、アッヴィやアドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（AMD）による大型案件が発行額を押し上げた。

ベロ氏は「記録的な供給がある一方、需要も過去最高となっている」と述べた。こうした需給関係により、9月の大量発行は懸念されるほど大きな問題にはならない可能性があるという。

LONDON, Aug 24 : England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been dropped from the squad for the second test against Pakistan following an investigation into an incident at a club in Derby, the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) said on Monday.
"Following a referral from the ECB, the Cricket Regulator has confirmed that they will investigate events on Saturday night in Derby," the ECB said in a statement.
"Brydon Carse will no longer be available for selection for the second men's test while this investigation is ongoing and the full facts are obtained."
Carse, who did not play in the opening test victory at Headingley, will be replaced by Sonny Baker.

Videos circulated on social media appearing to show the 31-year-old Durham bowler in handcuffs being spoken to by police officers outside a venue. According to reports, Carse was not arrested and no charges were brought.
It has been a busy summer for England's Cricket Regulator, the body set up to investigate matters where there is an allegation of a breach of the ECB's code of conduct.
In June it concluded an investigation into former test captain Ben Stokes and fast bowler Gus Atkinson after a nightclub incident following the first test against New Zealand.
Both were left out of the second test before the Regulator ruled that there was insufficient evidence to establish that any regulatory breach occurred.
The latest investigation comes five days after England's returning test captain Joe Root spoke of the players being "really good role models and human beings" following a series of incidents and accusations of a drinking culture.
Controversy has followed England around in recent times with off-field issues during last winter’s tours, including Harry Brook being fined £30,000 ($41,000) following an altercation in Wellington as well as reports of drinking during a mid-Ashes series trip to Noosa.
Stokes retired from international cricket after returning for the third test against New Zealand and Brendon McCullum was sacked as test coach.

items.title: Mexico's Sheinbaum says return to post of governor facing U.S. drug charges was 'not appropriate'
items.author: Raul Cortes, Natalia Siniawski
items.creator: Raul Cortes, Natalia Siniawski
items.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Monday it was "reckless" and "not appropriate" for Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya to return to his post while facing a domestic investigation following U.S. drug trafficking allegations.
items.body:
Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Monday it was "reckless" and "not appropriate" for Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya to return to his post while facing a domestic investigation following U.S. drug trafficking allegations.
Rocha, 77, a member of the ruling Morena party, dramatically [USN:L1N44I0K2 TEXT:"returned to office"] on Friday but [USN:L1N44K005 TEXT:"backtracked"] on Saturday following sharp backlash from Sheinbaum and others.
Sheinbaum has trod carefully around the explosive allegations against Rocha. While rejecting a U.S. extradition request as lacking sufficient evidence, she has backed a Mexican investigation into the governor and hinted that his push to return to office was driven by self-interest.
U.S. prosecutors charged Rocha in April with conspiring with the Sinaloa Cartel to traffic drugs into the United States in exchange for bribes and political support. Rocha is the first sitting governor in Mexico to face drug trafficking charges by the U.S.
Rocha has denied the charges, calling them a politically motivated attack. He stepped down for three months before announcing on X on Friday that he had resumed power with a "clear conscience" and his "head held high."
"I had no prior knowledge that he wanted to return," Sheinbaum said at her daily morning press conference on Monday. "I don't know what led the governor — who is once again on leave — to return," Sheinbaum added. "I haven't spoken to him, nor do I intend to."
The Sinaloa state congress is expected to appoint an interim governor this week.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [カイロ　２４日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[カイロ　２４日　ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２４日、サウジアラビアの紅海沿岸にあるヤンブー港沖で船舶を攻撃したと発表した。同派の軍事報道官ヤヒヤ・サリー氏がテレビ演説で明らかにした。

サウジアラビアの国営海運会社バハリも同日、自社の船舶「アムザン」が紅海で攻撃を受けたと声明で明らかにした。

これに先立ち、英海事貿易機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は、ヤンブーの西方６３カイリの海域でタンカーが正体不明の飛翔体による攻撃を受けたと発表。ＵＫＭＴＯによると、乗組員全員の安全が確認されており、環境への影響も報告されていないという。

ヤンブーはサウジの主要な紅海沿岸の石油積み出し港で、１日あたり数百万バレルの石油が積み出されている。また、イランが封鎖しているホルムズ海峡を迂回するサウジ産原油の主要な輸出ルートとなっている。

items.title: Former world champion Dott convicted of historical sexual abuse
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court.
items.body:
Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court.
Dott was charged with two counts of "lewd, indecent and libidinous behaviour", against a girl between 1993 and 1996, and a boy between 2006 and 2010.
The indictment alleged that the 49-year-old had sexually assaulted the girl, exposed himself to her and induced her to touch him. Dott was also accused of making sexual remarks to the boy and touching his genitals.
He denied the charges but was found guilty after a trial at the High Court in Glasgow. He will be sentenced next month.
"Dott is a dangerous individual and I hope this conviction provides some measure of comfort to those impacted by his crimes," Detective Inspector Gary Smillie from Police Scotland told reporters.
Dott won the world snooker championship in 2006, beating Peter Ebdon 18-14 in the final, and twice finished as runner-up in 2004 and 2010.
He was suspended by the World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association after the charges were announced last year.

items.title: 米国、対イラン追加制裁を発表へ－財務長官「経済的生命線全て断つ」
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランに対する新たな経済制裁措置を発表する見通しだ。約6カ月に及ぶ戦争の終結を目指し、米政府は軍事攻撃の威嚇から、徹底した経済制裁による圧力強化へと軸足を移す。

ベッセント氏は予定している会見で、イランを一段と効果的に孤立させる計画の詳細を明らかにする。米国は数十年にわたり広範な対イラン制裁を科してきたが、今回さらに強化する。具体的な内容は不明だが、中国やトルコ、インドなどイランの主要貿易相手国の一部に影響が及ぶ可能性がある。

アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）は先週、イランとの経済関係を全て断絶したと発表。湾岸の米同盟国によるこうした動きが、ワシントンの戦略を後押ししている。

ベッセント氏は英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）への寄稿で、「世界は、イランが孤立するまで、この圧政政権を支えるあらゆる経済的生命線を断つことがわれわれの目的だと理解すべきだ」と述べた。

イラン経済は既に極めて厳しい状況にあり、米海軍による海上封鎖で重要な原油輸出が大幅に制限されている。

イランでは年間インフレ率が80％を超え、人口9000万人の国民への圧力が一段と強まっている。イラン通貨リアルは対ドルで過去最安値に沈む。トランプ米大統領が先週、イランへの経済圧力を強める計画を明らかにして以降、4.5％下落した。

イランはこれまでも制裁をしのいできた経緯があり、米国の今回の措置が新たな軍事攻撃を招く恐れもある。イランは、米国の制裁計画を支援する国には報復すると警告した。2月下旬の戦争開始以降、イランは湾岸の米同盟国に数千発のミサイルやドローンを撃ち込んでいる。

イラン最高安全保障委員会のレザイ事務局長は23日夜、「米国によるイラン国民への経済戦争に参加したり、これを支援したりする国の行為を戦争行為とみなす」とXへの投稿で表明。

その上で、「ホルムズ海峡からも、ペルシャ湾のどこからも、原油は一滴たりとも輸出されなくなる」と述べた。

JOHANNESBURG, Aug 24 : New Zealand flyhalf Richie Mo'unga will don an All Blacks jersey on Tuesday for the first time since the last World Cup final as he makes a bid for a place in the squad for next year’s global tournament.
Mo'unga will start against the Lions at Ellis Park as New Zealand play the last game against provincial opposition on their eight-match tour of South Africa.
The 32-year-old was called up as an injury replacement in an effort by new coach Dave Rennie to integrate him into the squad one year out from the 2027 World Cup in Australia.
"One reason for coming back was obviously to win a World Cup, but to not have any regrets of ‘geez, I wish I had given it another crack or maybe there was a bit more to give," Mo’unga told reporters on Monday.
